label: The Artist
tagline: A loop that allows the artifact to be wrong, for a while.
cluster_explainer: The Artist sits in the cross cluster — they generate where the auditor only reads, and they read their own process while they make, not after.
demo_highlights: Torus reads as an open seam — a loop that does not close, the way a work-in-progress refuses to finish itself
Mid-band reactance tracks the harmonic body of a room, where an artist feels whether the piece is breathing
Smoke preset is the most forgiving of the available styles — it lets the artifact stay illegible without flattening it
Smooth envelope (0.7) absorbs transients so the visual does not impose a 'now you've made something' punctuation
No completionist affordance in the demo: the loop continues without auto-export, so the artifact can stay wrong
